title: Meal
description: One scheduled meal slot of one dog, with every visit during that slot. Firestore path: meals/{meal_id}. Written by the feeder through the ESP32-CAM; read by the AI server and the app.

dog_id.description: The dog this meal slot belongs to.

status.description: completed: full portion served. partial: the dog left before the full portion.

first_arrival_at.description: When this meal's dog first arrived. null if it never came.

bowl_grams_at_start.description: Food already in the bowl when the slot began (leftovers from an earlier meal).

grams_dispensed.description: Total dispensed during this slot, all visits.

grams_eaten.description: Eaten by this meal's dog only (sum of its visits).

grams_left_in_bowl.description: Bowl weight when the slot ended.

logged_offline.description: true when the meal was saved on the SD card and synced later.
